rows.note: Use 有趣 as the all-purpose choice for something that engages your attention or holds your interest.

example.english: This book about marine life is interesting.
example.traditional: 呢本書講海洋生物，好有趣。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 gong2 hoi2 joeng4 sang1 mat6 hou2 jau5 ceoi3

rows.note: Use 得意 when the thing is interesting because it is amusing, unusual, or charming rather than simply informative.

example.english: Your cat can open the door by itself—that's interesting.
example.traditional: 你隻貓識自己開門，真係得意。
example.jyutping: nei5 zek3 maau1 sik1 zi6 gei2 hoi1 mun4 zan1 hai6 dak1 ji3

rows.note: Use 好睇 especially for a film, programme, book, game, or other thing that is engaging to watch or follow.

example.english: This movie is so interesting that I don't want to go to sleep.
example.traditional: 呢套戲好睇到我唔捨得瞓。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 tai2 dou3 ngo5 m4 se2 dak1 fan3
